name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TEST-BISECTION BUILD (v0.6.4.0): PROACTIVE-ONLY three-trigger architecture (1. compose-window-open -> unconditional CertVerifier rebuild; 2. send button/menu intercepted before the real send -> cleanup, no reinit, original send runs exactly once; 3. shutdown -> cleanup), but doCleanup() is a NO-OP after acquiring the nsIX509CertDB service: it gets the service object, logs, and returns [] -- no getCerts(), no cert9.db read, no deleteCertificate. Purpose: test the hypothesis that merely resolving Cc['@mozilla.org/security/x509certdb;1'].getService(Ci.nsIX509CertDB) at send time already corrupts later reading of incoming mail (bisection against 0.6.3 which added getCerts()+SELECT+delete back into the send path; 0.6.2 proved 0 live-certs still broke reading, so state corruption happens even without any delete). Same CA-excluding getEmailAddresses() logic as 0.6.3 is present but unreachable in this build.
